extracted.name: Taco Sauce
extracted.description: A simple taco sauce to serve with any type of tacos. Adds that extra bit of flavour and sauce. It rivals any jar you'll buy from the store - except you know exactly what goes in it! Great to freeze in serving size portions.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups / 500ml tomato passata / puree OR 1 can (16 ounce) US tomato sauce ( (Note 1))
1/4 + teaspoon cayenne pepper ((adjust heat to taste))
instruction_lines: Place all ingredients in a saucepan. Mix then simmer for 10 minutes on medium low.
Transfer to serving bowl, cool and serve with tacos or other Mexican dishes requiring a sauce. Makes around 2.5 cups.
Or cool, then refrigerate for up to 5 days OR freeze.
